notes: Group: Rebel Cell. FULL portrait site overlay printed sideways that RENAMES the site: bars '◊ REBEL CELL - SITUATION ROOM' (hollow ◊, red on Light bar, white on Dark bar). Art window blank. Light half (right) = game_text, Dark half (left) = dark_text. One blue saber; Dark bar ALSO prints one red saber (the printed Briefing Room has no Dark Force icon — the slip adds it). Icon boxes both bars, outermost first: planet, exterior (sky with suns), interior (beige room); NO scomp ring (the printed card has scomp on both halves and no exterior icon — the slip drops scomp and adds exterior). Bottom margin: VS15 set sphere only → icons []; the printed card's ANH ring is not on the slip. CHANGES vs printed Yavin 4: Briefing Room (A New Hope, unique •; Light 'If you control, with a leader here, may add 1 to total of Attack Run.' / Dark 'If you control, Force drain +1 here and subtract 1 from total of Attack Run.'): renamed ◊, both texts replaced, icons as above. Slip text matches the stub. Base 490×350 only; copyright ANH 1996 read off the scan. Modern: VB4-L-rebelcellsituationroom-pre.gif (Virtual Block 4; art only).
